chunks: Some of our companions, from Ibn Jamhūr, from his father, from Sulaymān ibn Samāʿah, from ʿAbdullāh ibn al-Qāsim, from al-Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar, who said:

Abū Jaʿfar al-Manṣūr sent to al-Ḥasan ibn Zayd, who was his governor over the two sanctuaries, ordering: Burn down the house of Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad. So he cast fire into the house of Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, and the fire caught at the door and the corridor. Then Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام came out, stepping over the fire and walking through it.
And he was saying: I am the son of the roots of the earth; I am the son of Ibrāhīm, the Khalīl of Allah, عليه السلام.

key_terms.أَعْرَاقِ: roots or lineage, indicating ancestral origin
key_terms.النَّارَ: the fire that was cast into the house
key_terms.الْحَرَمَيْنِ: the two sacred sanctuaries, meaning Makkah and al-Madīnah
key_terms.خَلِيلِ اللَّهِ: the intimate friend of Allah, a title of Prophet Ibrāhīm عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What happened when al-Manṣūr ordered the house of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام to be burned?
ai.summary: This report recounts that al-Manṣūr ordered the burning of the house of Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad عليه السلام through his governor over the two sanctuaries. The Imam عليه السلام emerged through the flames unharmed while invoking his noble descent from Ibrāhīm Khalīl Allāh عليه السلام, highlighting his steadfastness and the extraordinary protection associated with the Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام.

en.hubeali: Some of our companions, from Ibn Jamhour, from his father, from Suleyman Bin Sama’at, from Abdullah Bin Al Qasim, from Al Mufazzal Bin Umar who said,

‘Abu Ja’far Al-Mansour (the Caliph) directed Al-Hassan Bin Zayd, and he was his governor upon the two Harrums (in Makkah and Al-Medina), that he burn down upon Ja’farasws Bin Muhammadasws, hisasws house. So, he cast the fire in the house of Abu Abdullahasws, and the fire took hold in the door and the corridor. Abu Abdullahasws came out skipping the fire and walking in it,
and heasws was saying: ‘Iasws am the sonasws of ‘A’araq Al-Sara’ (Ismailas)! Iasws am the sonasws of Ibrahimas, Friend of Allahazwj!’
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Abdallah ibn Ahmad from Ibrahim ibn al-Hassan who has said that Wahab ibn Hafs narrated to me from Ishaq ibn Jarir who has said the following.

“Abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) has said, ‘Sa‘id ibn al-Musayyib, al-Qasim ibn md ibn abu Bakr and abu al-Khalid al-Kabuli were of the trusted and reliable companions of Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.).” The Imam (a.s.) has said, “My mother was a true beliver, pious and a person of good deeds. Allah loves the people of ggod deeds.”

He has said, “My mother has said that my father said, “O ’Umm Farwa, I pray to Allah to forgive the sins of the sinners of our Shi‘a (followers) a thousand times a day because we exercise patience knowing well the facts of reward but they exercise patience in that of which they have no knowledge.”
